defs.def: a set of steps built between two floors inside a building 楼梯

ex.s: （1）What made the author start to climb up the stairs to the mountain top？（no more than 5 words）
ex.t: （4）你如何理解最后一段中划线的句子？（不超过5个词）

ex.s: Henry: (after going down some stairs) Can you show me a suit, please?
ex.t: 亨利:(下楼梯后) 你能给我看一套西装,好吗?

ex.s: For example, when we come to an escalator (cue), our normal routine is to ride it, but we could change this routine into something more positive by taking the stairs instead.
ex.t: 例如,当我们来到一个自动扶梯(cue)时,我们正常的例行公事就是骑它,但是我们可以把这个例行公事改成更积极的事情,代之以走楼梯.

ex.s: Within one minute and twenty seconds, the whole class went down the stairs and rushed to the playground.
ex.t: 在1分20秒内,全班人员下楼梯,匆忙赶到操场.

ex.s: The alarm rang at 6 am The pair went down the stairs quietly to the kitchen.
ex.t: 闹钟在早上6点响了，两人悄悄走下楼梯来到厨房。

ex.s: The alarm rang at 6 am The pair went down the stairs quietly to the kitchen.
ex.t: 闹钟在早上6点响了，两人悄悄走下楼梯来到厨房。

defs.def: one of the steps in a set of stairs 梯级

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。有一天放学后，在探索这座壮丽山峰的翠绿树林时，我差点被一段台阶绊倒。这些台阶会通向哪里呢？好奇心占了上风，因为我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始攀登那些神秘莫测的台阶。

defs.def: 房子的门厅装有镶板墙裙，楼梯是用高级栎木建造的。

ex.s: To bed went Matthew.And to bed, when she had put her dishes away,went Marilla, frowning most resolutely.And up-stairs, in the east gable,alonely, heart-hungry, friendless child cried herself to sleep.
ex.t: 上床去 马修 睡觉去 当她把她的盘子放下时 文特·玛莉拉 皱眉最坚决
